<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market rally and RBI policy:</strong> The Sensex jumped over 800 points and the Nifty reclaimed the 24,200 level, supported by a strong IT sector rally following TCS earnings and the RBI’s decision to maintain the repo rate alongside a 6.9% GDP growth projection.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiRkFVX3lxTFBlamhNYUFOZ3ZnV2pKU2tXNWJfeWJ6MXZVSGZ5dEYwMlpEcVg0NHJ4S0VYLTJlOFk1YmVDMU92bmpNZWVKNmc?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxOTGFSNzg0VzlJdnMwYWh2TzliX3libXhnd0pFajdsbW05R3dZU3Y5V3BjRU5uV2Q0aDVOZWZNX3dDdHpvNXpGOXRTQlNnQVRScklzNU5QdjVmV2YzOWlFVWZXMXFSZWxscFJIdFY0UHhleHZreWhkRmhqNGpCeTBYTVlpZ3AxcFN5X0h6SkFqSHJzSTBhWER6N1lkQXB3cnlLRXU4TF95ZjNWdC01XzBkTm0zOGN3RmpXc1lQSkdR?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I20</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Crude oil derivatives activity:</strong> NSE crude oil options reached record levels, recording a daily premium turnover of Rs 2,006 crore and over 47 lakh in volume, reflecting heightened investor interest in energy hedging.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Currency stabilization:</strong> The Indian Rupee strengthened against the US dollar, recovering 14-15 paise to trade near 95.32, aided by the recent cooling of global crude oil prices.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxPOHVvcXlXSXdXQmNJMWF0Q0Q0dUFub1NjTWFpNTZRQmtkWUhqb1BmcGkwb0otUW44WFlIS25pelo0YXp2SjZicU93RU5UdEFpazR2WVpCZl9LNkJ6ZGlONmpvTm1ObFpkZThvZWx1Wkt0WEZLM2FnSE1LdlN5S3JWaGtmRUVJYVFXdF9Id1JIODgyRWpIS0U3cms4OC1IdXFOZ0ZCUGUzQV9VTnVWSlRXN3ZvdnlvUjVnYWhtTTRmVjdmeXRqZUFBQnl3?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiywFBVV95cUxNN0J6enVlYTJaTTNsbTVEUHV0bEwzbl80NmItRDZLSmRlV0dmVzJtSHNJN05qbE1KMjRpSGN6SzJTa000TlFzOUwzQ3B5aXN0em95VkJzX0hVdFhHeV9FbHNJZWxOd2dOVjBmb013NmxoSngyN0syNlFXckZQNl9zVEt6NjBEcncwby1aRUF4UWRTRWd4bjNjQnBVMFh5cEt0M0ZnQzdQbWRleTZ0andKZnduWC1IOUlCX2FBYko3c3NCMFVHd25ub2cyaw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a></span></li>
